company.name: planet9
company.shortDescription: planet9 is a neobank offering SaaS solutions for financial institutions, enabling instant remittance-based financing for migrants.
company.description:
planet9 is reshaping the financial landscape for migrants and their families with innovative, accessible solutions. Our SNPL solution in the MENA region lets migrants turn their remittance data into personalized loan options, empowering them to manage their finances with ease. Meanwhile, our RNPL product in Central Asia offers instant loans to families receiving remittances, breaking down barriers imposed by traditional banks.

With our AI-driven technology seamlessly integrated into existing financial platforms, we create tailored lending solutions that help migrants thrive and support their loved ones—no matter where they are in the world!

Just a heads up: While we’re passionate about providing innovative financial solutions, planet9 is not a licensed fintech company.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $400,000, or 61.54% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,150,000 to $12,400,000, a 2.41x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
